g.text: Six coordinated families · same warm bronze linework · Audio shown in the selected state
Romanesque arches, soft corners, devotional calm
Lantern and compass cues; alert without feeling harsh
Fine ticks and small flourishes, like an old instrument panel
Compact, modern forms with the same tactile bronze finish
Subtle stars and orbit lines for the app’s late-night ritual feel
Shielded, ceremonial shapes with a little more authority
All concepts stay legible at the current 27 px sidebar size; exact strokes would be hand-tuned after you pick a family.
A · Cloister keeps today’s familiar symbols,
but gives them a more architectural soul.
C · Engraved Brass best echoes the editorial,
old-instrument quality of the wider app.
E · Nocturne turns Vigil’s late-night ritual
mood into a subtle recurring motif.
B leans watchful · D leans clean and modern · F leans ceremonial and protective
